Frequently asked questions
Which taxes apply? Prices are shown without VAT. VAT is added according to the billing address on file; a valid intra-community VAT number removes it from the invoice.
Can an invoice be split between two cost centers? Yes: add the cost center codes in the customer portal before the end of the month and the next invoice shows one line per cost center.
How are hours counted? Instances are billed per started hour from launch to termination; stopped instances are not billed for compute but their attached volumes are.
Why did egress change? Egress is measured at the region boundary. Traffic between services in the same region is free; traffic to the internet is billed per GB after the first 100 GB.
Can we receive one invoice for several projects? Yes: ask your account representative to group projects under a single billing profile. The grouping applies from the next billing cycle.
What happens when a payment is late? A reminder is sent 7 and 14 days after the due date. Services are not interrupted for invoices under 30 days late.
How do we update the billing contact? Billing contacts are managed in the customer portal under Settings, Billing, Contacts. Changes apply to the next statement.
Where do we find past receipts? Receipts for the last 24 months are available in the portal; older ones can be requested from ar@nimbus-cloud.example.

Thank you for your business. Nimbus Cloud Services, Finance Operations, 14 quai de la Rapée, 75012 Paris.
